headline: Analysts recommend six stocks including Aditya Infotech and Thyrocare with target prices
hook: Six picks for the short term
summary: Market experts have highlighted six stocks for short-term trading as the Nifty 50 rebounds alongside falling crude prices. The recommended equities include Aditya Infotech, Thyrocare Technologies, and Mishra Dhatu Nigam (MIDHANI), alongside three other unnamed counters. Each recommendation comes with specified target prices and stop-loss levels to guide near-term trading strategies. Retail investors tracking short-term momentum can evaluate these technical setups against their own risk appetite.
why_it_matters: New short-term trading ideas for your watchlist
winners_losers: Short-term traders gain / unhedged positions hurt
